short_description: AI-powered conversational mental health platform with FDA Breakthrough Device designation for postpartum depression. Enterprise B2B model with clinical trials. See woebot-health for full details.
long_description: Woebot is a rule-based AI chatbot delivering CBT, DBT, and IPT therapeutic techniques. The company received FDA Breakthrough Device Designation in 2021 for postpartum depression treatment. Consumer app discontinued June 2025; now enterprise-only. Backed by 15+ RCTs. See woebot-health entry for comprehensive information.

faqs.q: Is Woebot still available as a consumer app?
faqs.a: No, Woebot discontinued its direct-to-consumer app on June 30, 2025. The platform is now enterprise-only for health systems, payers, and employers.
Woebot received FDA Breakthrough Device Designation in 2021 for postpartum depression treatment but is not yet FDA cleared.
